ONLINE COURSE PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT

This agreement is between Dana Cole and Felix Grant (the "Partners").

1. The Course

1.1 The Partners will sell an online course called "Ceramics at Home" (the "Course") through Dana Cole's online store.

1.2 Dana Cole runs the online store, handles customer support and sends payments to Felix Grant.

1.3 Felix Grant films and edits the Course videos.

2. Term

2.1 This agreement starts on June 1, 2026 and ends on May 31, 2027.

3. Sharing Course Revenue

3.1 "Course Revenue" means the total amount paid by students for the Course.

3.2 Dana Cole receives 60% of Course Revenue.

3.3 Felix Grant receives 40% of Course Revenue.

3.4 Dana Cole will send Felix Grant his share by the tenth day of each month for the previous month's sales.

4. Course Content

4.1 Both Partners may use clips from the Course to promote their own work.

5. Ending Early

5.1 Either Partner may end this agreement early on sixty (60) days' written notice.

Signed by Dana Cole and Felix Grant.
